info.title: OECP public catalogue API
info.description:
Anonymous, read-only catalogue API used by the portal (spec §7). No cookies, no authentication.

**Caching.** Successful responses carry `Cache-Control` (`public, max-age=60` for search and suggest, `public, max-age=300` for course pages, reference data and the sitemap) and a weak `ETag`; a matching `If-None-Match` answers 304. Errors are not cached.

**Rate limits.** Per client address at the edge proxy (spec §10): search 20 requests/s (burst 40), suggest and the viewer `/docs` 10/s (burst 20); other paths are not limited. Excess requests get 429 in plain text.

**Versioning.** Additive only: new endpoints, optional parameters and response members may be added; nothing is removed, renamed or given a new meaning. A breaking change means `/api/public/v2`, served alongside v1 for at least one minor release (`docs/RELEASING.md`).

**Conventions.** JSON members are snake_case (as the database); multilingual short labels are objects `{en, <lang>…}` that always contain `en`; dates are `YYYY-MM-DD` local to the offering `timezone`, timestamps ISO 8601 UTC; absent values are `null`, never omitted. Every error is RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` (`ProblemDetails`) with stable codes in `errors[].code` (spec §6.6, Appendix A).

The schemas are generated from the Zod contracts of `@oecp/schemas`, the single source of truth the API validates with. The OEAPI v5-compatible read API under `/oeapi/v5` (spec §9) is not described here: it follows the OEAPI v5.0 standard and its own OpenAPI document.

tags.name: Catalogue
tags.description: Search, course pages, suggestions, reference data and the sitemap (spec §7.1).

tags.description: This OpenAPI document, as JSON and as a page to read in the browser.

get.description:
Published, non-deleted courses with facet counts (spec §7.1). Repeated parameters (`partner=a&partner=b`) are OR-ed within a filter and AND-ed across filters; facets are disjunctive (each ignores its own filter).

**Alliance attributes:** `attr_<key>=<value>` (repeatable, at most 20 distinct keys) filters by an alliance attribute: values OR-ed within a key, keys AND-ed. Booleans take `true` or `false`; `enum`/`multi_enum` an option value. Keys without a definition are ignored; the filterable keys are listed by `GET /reference` (`attribute_definitions[].filterable`).

**Ranking:** `sort=relevance` (default with `q`) ranks by `ts_rank_cd` plus title trigram similarity; without `q` the default is `start_date`.

Per-client rate limit at the edge: 20 requests/s (burst 40).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text query (title, abstract, description, keywords…); one word also matches as a prefix and, from 3 characters, by trigram similarity.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: **Teaching** language: primary subtag of an offering `teaching_languages` (repeatable). The display language is `locale`.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Study cycle, matches any of a course `levels` (repeatable).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `relevance` (default with `q`), `title`, `start_date` (default otherwise), `deadline` (next open application deadline first, courses without one last).

parameters.name: includeUnscheduled
parameters.description: Older spelling of `upcoming=false`: `true` lists every published course. `upcoming` wins when both are given.

parameters.name: upcoming
parameters.description: Default `true`: only courses with a published offering whose `end_date` is today (UTC) or later. `false` lists every published course.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: **Display** language of resolved texts (`title`, `abstract`), primary subtag; English fallback. The `*_lang` members say which language was used.

200.description: One page of results with facets.

get.description: The course with its texts in every language (each with the optional IT Handbook texts), `instructors`, every attribute, published offerings (past ones included) and cancelled offerings not yet started, and the contact (course, else organization).

404.description: Malformed, unknown, unpublished or deleted id: `oecp.request.not_found`.

get.summary: View this document in the browser
get.description: HTML page that renders this document with Redoc, served by the API itself (bundle under `/api/docs-assets/`, no third-party origin; scripts and styles from the portal origin only). Anonymous and cacheable for an hour; 10 requests/s per client address (burst 20) at the edge proxy.

200.description: The viewer page (loads `openapi.json` from the same API).

get.description: This document, generated at start-up from the Zod contracts of `@oecp/schemas`; the copy in the repository is `docs/api/`. Anonymous and cacheable for an hour.

Organizations (with `idp_alias` for "Sign in through your university": the organization `keycloak_idp_alias` when it names an IdP enabled in the realm, else null), active delivery modes with their schema.org mode, ISCED broad fields, teaching languages in use, levels, kinds and alliance attribute definitions.
sitemaps.org `urlset` of the published courses as `{OECP_PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/en/courses/{id}` with `lastmod` (at most 50,000 URLs, built on request). The portal serves it as `/sitemap.xml`.

Up to `limit` title suggestions for `q`. Of each course the title in `locale` is suggested when it matches, else the English one, else the best match. Per-client rate limit at the edge: 10 requests/s (burst 20).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Alias of `locale` (this endpoint has no teaching-language filter).

CourseLevel.description: Study cycle (`levels[0]` is the primary one).

CourseSearchFacets.description: Disjunctive facet counts: each facet ignores its own filter. Keys are the query parameter names; `attributes` is keyed by attribute key (parameter `attr_<key>`).

ErrorCode.description:
Stable error code (spec §6.6, Appendix A; `packages/schemas/errors.json`). Codes are never renamed, reused or repurposed; new codes may be added in any release, so clients must tolerate unknown values.

**Request** (`oecp.request.*`, 3)

- `oecp.request.validation_failed`: Request validation failed
- `oecp.request.not_found`: Resource not found
- `oecp.request.not_implemented`: Not implemented

- `oecp.integration.header_name_required`: api_key_header_name is required for api_key_header authentication
- `oecp.integration.basic_secret_format`: A basic credential must be username:password
- `oecp.integration.secret_required`: A credential is required for this authentication scheme
- `oecp.integration.secret_not_expected`: auth_scheme none takes no credential

- `oecp.sync.rate_limited`: Sync now is limited to once per 15 minutes

**Course images** (`oecp.media.*`, 6)

- `oecp.media.too_large`: Image larger than 5 MiB

InvitationMismatchReason.description: Which check of `POST /invitations/accept` failed (problem member `reason` of `oecp.invitation.mismatch`): `email` (signed-in e-mail is not the invited address, 403), `idp` (not signed in through the organization IdP, 403), `home_organization` (the IdP did not assert the schacHomeOrganization, 403), `organization` (the account already administers another organization, 409).

LocalizedLabel.description: Short label keyed by BCP 47 language tag; always contains `en`. Clients show `label[locale] ?? label.en`.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`, the body of every error response. `errors[]` lists stable codes; `instance` is the request path. Extension members: `reason` on `oecp.invitation.mismatch` (see `InvitationMismatchReason`), `idp_alias` on `oecp.invitation.idp_not_enabled`, `sync_run_id`/`run_status`/`error_count`/`warning_count`/`processed_inline` on failed inline uploads. Problems raised by the framework itself (e.g. a malformed UUID in the path) carry `title` and `status` without `errors`.

ProblemError.description: One error or warning: CSV problems carry `file`, `row` (1-based, header = 1) and `column`; JSON bodies an RFC 6901 `pointer`.

PublicAttribute.description: An alliance attribute of a course, resolved with its definition; ordered by the definition `sort_order`, then key.

PublicCourseImage.description: Course image (decision 27): `url` (lg, inside 1600×1600) and `thumbnail_url` (sm, inside 640×640) are paths on the portal origin, `/media/courses/{id}/{key}.{lg|sm}.webp`; `alt` is keyed by language (empty alternative text when `decorative`); `width`/`height` of the lg file.

PublicOffering.description: Seats (DL 8): show `alliance_seats` when set and `seats_available` "as of `seats_updated_at`" when set; never compute remaining alliance seats.

PublicCourseId.name: courseId
PublicCourseId.description: Course id (UUID). Malformed, unknown, unpublished or deleted ids answer 404.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: Entity tag of a cached copy; a match answers 304 without a body.

Cache-Control.description: Set on successful responses only: `public, max-age=60` (search, suggest), `public, max-age=300` (course, reference, sitemap), `public, max-age=3600` (OpenAPI documents). Errors are never cached.

ETag.description: Weak entity tag of the body; send it back in `If-None-Match` to get a 304.

NotModified.description: The `If-None-Match` entity tag matches: no body.

TooManyRequests.description: Per-client rate limit of the edge proxy (Traefik); plain text, not problem+json. Retry later.
